Enable auto connect, auto exposure, file saving, and image flipping as needed. 4. Connect OUT to a downstream local calibration, POI, or other algorithm node.

data.name: Flow_LocalCamera_Processing
data.value: Camera RAW capture → spatial/general calibration → color calibration and CIE generation (when included in the template) → image flip → file save. Downstream POI nodes always use coordinates in the final image orientation.

data.value: X flips vertically, Y mirrors horizontally, and XY rotates 180°. Rotations of 90° and 270° are not supported. When no calibration template is selected, RAW is not flipped early; the orientation setting is preserved until downstream local calibration finishes.
